thread:
anya-support: FYI Acme just opened a ticket — they see p99 latency jump from ~120ms to ~420ms after last canary. screenshot + query attached.
ben-sre: can you paste the exact query the dashboard panel is using? might be rollup vs raw hist mismatch.
tim-observability: panel is using our histogram-derived quantile (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)) )
anya-support: here's the query the customer ran in their workspace (they exported):
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_ms_bucket{service="inference"}[5m])) by (le))
```
anya-support: their panel shows ~420ms, our internal raw traces p99 are ~130ms for same time window.
maria-platform: Deploy bot shows a canary rollout completed at 2024-06-08T13:02Z (deploy-789). Could the canary have different sampling or a different exporter config? :thinking_face:
sara-eng-oncall: @tim-observability quick check — are bucket boundaries identical between ingestion (customer) and our dashboard aggregation? common cause is different 'le' bucket set or OpenMetrics histogram re-bucketing.
tim-observability: good call. our global buckets: [0,10,25,50,100,200,500,1000] ms. customer claims their exporter uses custom buckets: [0,5,15,50,150,300,600] ms. that will shift histogram_quantile results.
ben-sre: yep, quantile on different bucketization is not comparable. histogram_quantile interpolates between buckets; coarser buckets can inflate p99 if bucket ceilings jump.
anya-support: customer insists platform dashboard is 'broken' — they pasted a screenshot of our public status panel (viz is on their tenant).
deploy-bot: deploy-789 canary -> stable completed by @maria-platform at 2024-06-08T13:05Z :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert PD#2345 triggered: Acme p99 latency > 300ms (alert source: tenant-metrics-ingest). Escalation sent to eng-oncall.
sara-eng-oncall: mitigation options: 1) change panel to use raw spans/traces for p99 (trace-derived p99) 2) update quantile query to use consistent bucketization or re-ingest with histogram normalization 3) temporary alert threshold while we investigate. Which one do we do now?
maria-platform: short-term: roll canary back? but traces show no backend change for latency. I suspect this is ingestion/bucket mismatch. rolling back won't help if it's exporter difference on customer side.
ben-sre: quick repro for us to validate: curl example to reproduce high-latency bucket:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REPRO_KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"hello","max_tokens":512}' &
# run 200 concurrent for 30s
```
ben-sre: I'll run the repro against canary and stable to compare trace spans and exporter buckets.
tim-observability: also add this diagnostic panel to the tenant: show request_latency_ms_bucket counts for both customer and our infra for same time slice, and overlay 'le' labels. if le sets differ you'll see mismatched bin edges.
anya-support: customer provided raw metric sample (csv):
```
le,count
5,125
15,235
50,980
150,1205
300,1230
600,1240
+Inf,1240
```
anya-support: that confirms their exporter is sending the smaller-bucket set.
sara-eng-oncall: action plan: 1) update tenant dashboard docs to note bucketization caveat (short) 2) create follow-up for SDK/exporter to align default buckets (ENG-4521) 3) for Acme create tenant-scoped dashboard using our standard buckets or switch panel to use trace p99 for now.
maria-platform: I'll provision a tenant-scoped dashboard overlay and set alerting to use trace-derived p99 (non-rollup) until SDK fix. ETA 30m.
ben-sre: I've started repro runs and attached traces to the incident. trace p99 aligns with our internal metrics (~130ms). histogram_quantile from customer's exported buckets produces ~420ms for same traces.
tim-observability: filing short doc in Observability repo explaining why histogram_quantile can diverge across bucketizations. will link in the tenant ticket.
anya-support: customer happy with tenant-scoped panel fallback for now. they asked we avoid rollbacks. closing customer-facing loop.
sara-eng-oncall: marking incident as triaged. follow-ups: ENG-4521 (exporter defaults), OBS-324 (docs), TENANT-1010 (Acme dashboard overlay). I'll create tickets and link. :thumbsup:
anya-support: thanks team. logging postmortem notes in support ticket and leaving thread for follow-ups.
